newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Low offer in Taiwan jet fuel tender around $245/T.
newsitem.headline: Low offer in Taiwan jet fuel tender around $245/T.

text.p: Low offers in Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp's (CPC) jet fuel purchase tender for November are around $245 a tonne, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis, a CPC source said on Tuesday.
The 32,000-tonne cargo is for November 1-30 delivery to Keelung or Shen Ao. The source said the tender attracted over 10 offers.
The tender, which closed on October 7, would be awarded later this evening, the source said. CPC is now working on awarding only one cargo, the source said.
In its last tender, CPC bought two 32,000-tonne jet fuel cargoes at $244.80 and $247.82 per tonne for October 1-31 delivery, on a c-and-f basis.
